scenes.say: This year's Vegas winner takes home their very own neon sign.
The trophy is shaped like a V, for Vegas and victory. Fans instantly joked that V stands for Verstappen.
One hundred and twenty-two lights and a red outline, like the old marquees on Fremont Street.
Fifty-six centimetres tall and three point six kilos. Easy to lift after the race.
The old trophy echoed the desert rock: a bronze base made to look like sandstone and a lit chrome top.
The new one took about six months to make. It's only the second design in the race's history.
See who lifts it on Saturday on the LapRadar live map.

title: A neon sign for the winner: the new Las Vegas Grand Prix trophy
